lines.text: A drone asks every strip of tundra one question. Is that made of something the ground isn't?
lines.t: A drone asks every strip of tundra one question. Is that made of something the ground isn't?

lines.text: Crews often fly regular and infrared cameras, which can miss camouflaged or insulated people.
lines.t: Crews often fly regular and infrared cameras, which can miss camouflaged or insulated people.

lines.text: This hyperspectral camera sees a hundred and fifty bands of light, revealing material differences.
lines.t: This hyperspectral camera sees a hundred and fifty bands of light, revealing material differences.

lines.text: The catch is the flood of data, one line at a time.
lines.t: The catch is the flood of data, one line at a time.

lines.text: On a Raspberry Pi riding the drone, the anomaly detector by itself took twenty one milliseconds a line. A new line comes every ten.
lines.t: On a Raspberry Pi riding the drone, the anomaly detector by itself took twenty one milliseconds a line. A new line comes every ten.

lines.text: So researchers built SABL, a faster pipeline for the same detector. It scores pixels for anomalies, then clusters the standouts.
lines.t: So researchers built SABL, a faster pipeline for the same detector. It scores pixels for anomalies, then clusters the standouts.

lines.text: Now a line takes under six milliseconds, right on the drone.
lines.t: Now a line takes under six milliseconds, right on the drone.

lines.text: Each cluster becomes a flag, a G P S point to go check.
lines.t: Each cluster becomes a flag, a G P S point to go check.

lines.text: The test ran with Quinhagak Search and Rescue, a volunteer nonprofit in a Yup'ik village off the road system.
lines.t: The test ran with Quinhagak Search and Rescue, a volunteer nonprofit in a Yup'ik village off the road system.

lines.text: Researchers simulated a search with waders, nets and buoys, mostly donated by the community.
lines.t: Researchers simulated a search with waders, nets and buoys, mostly donated by the community.

lines.text: On the mudflat, about fifty six percent of flags were planted items, and it caught fifty five percent of the items.
lines.t: On the mudflat, about fifty six percent of flags were planted items, and it caught fifty five percent of the items.

lines.text: In swamp grass, at a different threshold, about ninety nine percent were planted items, but it caught just twenty nine percent.
lines.t: In swamp grass, at a different threshold, about ninety nine percent were planted items, but it caught just twenty nine percent.

lines.text: It keeps up. The question now is what it misses.
lines.t: It keeps up. The question now is what it misses.

lines.text: Here's the strongest case against it. The paper's pitch for hyperspectral is camouflage.
lines.t: Here's the strongest case against it. The paper's pitch for hyperspectral is camouflage.

lines.text: The authors say cutting false alarms can drop real hits, and stricter settings can hide camouflaged objects.
lines.t: The authors say cutting false alarms can drop real hits, and stricter settings can hide camouflaged objects.

lines.text: So it can go quiet in the very case it's pitched for.
